sort(Shape3D[], int, Comparator<Shape3D>, String) - Method in class managers.SortController
This method: - Sorts the given array of Shape3D objects - Uses the sort type code to determine which algorithm to run - Supports: → b = Bubble Sort → s = Selection Sort → i = Insertion Sort → m = Merge Sort → q = Quick Sort → z = AI Sort - Prints an error message if the sort type is unknown
SortController - Class in managers
This class: - Selects which sorting algorithm to use - Calls the appropriate SortUtility method based on the user's input - Acts as a controller between the UI and the sorting logic
